structured.answer: The page puts its star on "פסגות" with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", and says I'd have about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years from 70,000 ₪ put in. My own big bank comes out lower (Leumi 83,396, Hapoalim 81,471). I wouldn't act on it alone, though. I'll ask you first, and maybe the bank.

stuck.why: It opens with 'מדד', 'S&P 500', 'MSCI', 'נאסד"ק'. For me מדד is the price index on the news. If not for the task I would have left right there.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes with sliders
stuck.why: I didn't touch the sliders. I wasn't sure whether 'סכום היום 10,000' and 'הפקדה חודשית 500' were mine or just an example. The small grey line says 'לדוגמה של האתר'.
A coloured bar with numbers I couldn't read, and 'הקרן 58 ₪ פחות' / 'המס 14 ₪ יותר'. I didn't know whether that was good or bad.
Red numbers with minus signs, like −447 ₪, −1,268 ₪ and −3,671 ₪. I didn't know if those were losses, and it frightened me.
Whole lines in English with codes (IE00B5BMR087, iShares, Vanguard, UCITS). That's where I stopped.

used: Title 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Right-hand list of accounts: פסגות 86,492, לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, הפועלים 81,471
skimmed: Small grey line under the boxes, 'אינפלציה … שער הדולר 3.17'
Coloured tags on each fund: צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, קרן מחקה, etc.
skipped: The 'לא בחישוב' notes and the small arrows to open them
unsure_meaning: מדד (stock index, not the price index)
S&P 500, MSCI, ETF, UCITS, ISIN codes
קרן מחקה, קרן סל, צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד
Coloured bars in the accounts list, colours too close together
not_found: Anything about safety or deposits, or comparing to a פיקדון
How much of the 86,492 is profit and how much I could lose
Whether a bank adviser would charge me

findings.what: Red minus numbers next to the funds look like losses even if they are only differences. They scare people off.
The page opens with English letters and 'מדד' and no explanation for beginners
Dark background with small grey text; hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: All screens, especially the notes under the numbers

findings.what: Too many coloured tags and numbers on one screen
Lines entirely in English with long codes
Sliders for the inputs; not clear these are example numbers I should change
The bar colours (orange/yellow/red) are too close to tell apart and have no plain explanation
No word on risk: the result 86,492 looks like a sure thing
